scheme_name: Nirmaan Shramik  ke Bachchon Hetu  Utkrasht Khel Protsaahan Yojana
description:
The Nirmaan Shramik ke Bachchon Hetu Utkrasht Khel Protsaahan Yojana is a welfare scheme launched by the Government of India to promote sports among the children of construction workers. 

This scheme was officially launched on 1st January 2021. 

It aims to provide financial assistance and support to children of construction workers to encourage their participation in sports activities. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to identify and nurture sports talent among the children of construction workers. 

The government seeks to provide a platform for these children to excel in various sports disciplines. 

The scheme specifically targets children aged between 6 to 18 years. 

It aims to support children from families whose annual income does not exceed ₹3 lakh. 

The scheme is designed to benefit children who are enrolled in schools and are actively participating in sports. 

The financial assistance provided under the scheme includes a one-time grant of ₹10,000 for each child. 

This grant can be utilized for purchasing sports equipment and for training purposes. 

The scheme also includes provisions for organizing sports events and competitions at the district and state levels. 

The government aims to conduct these events annually, providing a platform for children to showcase their talents. 

Eligibility for the scheme is strictly limited to children of registered construction workers. 

The construction workers must be registered under the Building and Other Construction Workers (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act, 1996. 

To apply for the scheme, applicants must provide proof of their parent's registration as a construction worker. 

Additionally, applicants must submit a copy of their birth certificate or school admission certificate to verify their age. 

The application process involves filling out a specific form available at local government offices or online portals. 

Applicants must also attach a passport-sized photograph and proof of income to the application form. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The timeline for processing applications is typically within 30 days from the date of submission. 

Disbursement of the financial assistance is made directly to the bank account of the beneficiary. 

The government aims to disburse funds within 15 days after the approval of the application. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Ministry of Labour and Employment. 

The scheme is executed at the state level by the respective Labour Departments. 

Each state has designated officers responsible for the implementation and monitoring of the scheme. 

The contact details for the Ministry of Labour and Employment can be found on their official website. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to enhance the welfare of construction workers and their families. 

The government recognizes the significant contribution of construction workers to the economy. 

As per the 2011 Census, there are approximately 50 million construction workers in India. 

The Nirmaan Shramik ke Bachchon Hetu Utkrasht Khel Protsaahan Yojana aims to uplift the socio-economic status of these families. 

By promoting sports, the government also aims to instill discipline and teamwork among children. 

The scheme is expected to create a positive impact on the physical and mental health of the beneficiaries. 

It encourages children to engage in physical activities, reducing the risk of lifestyle diseases. 

The government has set a target to enroll at least 1 lakh children under the scheme in the first year. 

This target is part of a larger goal to promote sports at the grassroots level across the country. 

The scheme also aligns with the National Sports Policy which emphasizes the importance of sports in education. 

The government plans to collaborate with various sports federations to provide training and mentorship to the beneficiaries. 

This collaboration aims to ensure that children receive professional guidance in their chosen sports. 

The scheme also promotes inclusivity by encouraging participation from children of all backgrounds. 

Special emphasis is placed on the participation of girls in sports activities. 

The government aims to achieve a gender balance in sports participation through this initiative. 

The Nirmaan Shramik ke Bachchon Hetu Utkrasht Khel Protsaahan Yojana is a significant step towards recognizing the potential of children from marginalized communities. 

It aims to break the barriers that often prevent these children from pursuing their dreams in sports. 

The scheme also serves as a motivational factor for children to excel in their academics alongside sports. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹100 crore for the implementation of this scheme in the first year. 

This budget is expected to cover the costs of grants and the organization of sports events. 

The scheme is monitored through a robust framework to ensure transparency and accountability. 

Regular audits and evaluations are conducted to assess the impact of the scheme on beneficiaries. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is also collected to improve the scheme further. 

The government aims to expand the scheme in the coming years based on its success and feedback. 

Overall, the Nirmaan Shramik ke Bachchon Hetu Utkrasht Khel Protsaahan Yojana is a comprehensive initiative aimed at empowering the children of construction workers. 

It provides them with the necessary resources and opportunities to excel in sports. 

The scheme not only focuses on sports but also aims to foster overall development among children. 

By investing in the future of these children, the government hopes to create a healthier and more active generation. 

The scheme reflects the government's commitment to social welfare and the upliftment of marginalized communities. 

It is a crucial step towards building a more inclusive society where every child has the opportunity to succeed. 

The Nirmaan Shramik ke Bachchon Hetu Utkrasht Khel Protsaahan Yojana is a testament to the government's efforts in promoting sports and physical education in India.
